items.h: Is Brian Thomas Jr.'s playing time being impacted by an emerging Jaguars rookie?
items.s: Thomas was targeted just once in Week 3. Will he rebound against the Bengals, or will other Jaguars pass catchers get all the work?

items.h: The Jaguars selected Cameron in the sixth round of the 2026 NFL Draft, 191st overall.
items.s: Cameron (6-foot-1, 220 pounds) played five years at Baylor and started every game in each of his final two seasons, making use of his big-bodied frame to total 19 touchdowns from 2024-25. As a rookie with Jacksonville, Cameron may successfully carve out opportunities as a situational big-play threat, but to earn a larger role than that at the NFL level he'll need to make significant developmental strides as a route runner.
